## Balsa

![Display of balsa blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fa75063d4d34831c47c38170f43acf8f86dbbfad.jpeg)
Balsa adds a new type of wood from the real world, Balsa Wood. Balsa wood is solid in real life and has a slightly less brown appearance. 

The Balsa mod now features a brand new Balsa forest and all updated wood variants (hanging signs, chest boats, etc.)
